rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rm -rf examples/rlfe cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/examples/rlfe" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/examples/" ln -sf "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/examples/rlfe/readline"
ln -sf $(cd $AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/shlib && ls libreadline.so.*.*) \ "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/shlib/libreadline.so"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/examples/rlfe" && ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
make -C "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/examples/rlfe" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -D_GNU_SOURCE" CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" \ LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -g -L$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/shlib" \ LIBS="-lreadline -ltinfo -lutil" rlfe
